```{r, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)
library(dplyr)
library(spatialsample)
library(waywiser)
library(vip)
library(themis)
library(yardstick)
library(important) 
library(filtro)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
my_wd_all_dat <- "project_dir"

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(my_wd_all_dat))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
data_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output/parcels_predictors_05_final.gpkg")
```

# Data preparation

## Define model of interest

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# runs via 00_run_all
cat("Selected model:", selected_model)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
dat <- data_raw %>% 
    filter(dep_dens == "densification") %>%
  filter(parceltype == selected_model)
```

## Load and Prepare Data

```{r, include=FALSE}
# remove variables which are not needed in the model
base_drop <- c(
  "dep_dens", "dep_dens_cat", "dep_fa_23", "dif_fa", "parceltype", "service_quality_chg", "service_quality_2020", "center_quality"
)

nbu_extra_drop <- c(
  "dep_dens", "dep_dens_cat", "dif_fa_perc", "dep_fa_23", "parceltype",
  "share_area_foot_par", "share_floorspace_par", "largest_nonbuiltup", "fa_13",
  "bldg_flats_sum", "ucp_par", "bldg_age_median", "par_renov_recon", "bldg_type",
  "persons_total_par", "persons_per_fa", "ave_age_par", "only_75_older_par",
  "under_16_present_par", "share_area_par_nbr", "share_floorspace_par_nbr"
)
drop_cols <- if (params$run_id == "nbu") {
  nbu_extra_drop
} else {
  base_drop
}

data_reg <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(drop_cols)) %>%   # any_of avoids errors if a col is missing
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.factor))

## conditional selection of dependent variabel (for nbu we need to select dif_fa instead of dif_fa_perc)
if (params$run_id == "nbu") {
  
  data_reg <- data_reg %>%
    mutate(dep_var = log(dif_fa)) %>%
    select(-dif_fa)
  
} else {
  
data_reg <- data_reg %>%
    mutate(dep_var = log(dif_fa_perc)) %>%
    select(-dif_fa_perc)
}

# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(data_reg))

# Remove rows with missing values (if necessary)
data <- na.omit(data_reg) 
```

## Preparations for tidymodel

```{r}
trainDat <- data

predictor_names <- trainDat %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  select(id_par_merge, area_par:bezirksteil) %>% # id can be kept, as later on we define it as ID in the recipe
  names()

predictor_names

response_name <- "dep_var"
```

### Define recipe including balancing of training data and tunable feature selection

```{r define-recipe}
formula <- as.formula(paste(
  response_name,
  "~",
  paste(predictor_names, collapse = " + ")
))

recipe <- recipes::recipe(formula, data = trainDat) %>% 
  update_role(id_par_merge, new_role = "ID") %>%
  update_role(bezirksteil, new_role = "ID") %>%
  update_role(bezirk, new_role = "ID") %>%
  important::step_predictor_best(
    all_predictors(),        
    score      = "imp_rf",   
    prop_terms = tune(),     
    id         = "feat_sel"
  )

recipe
```

### Define model

```{r define-model-spec}
rf_model <- parsnip::rand_forest(mode = "regression") %>% 
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity")
```

### Create workflow

```{r create-workflow}
workflow <- workflows::workflow() %>% 
  workflows::add_recipe(recipe) %>% 
  workflows::add_model(rf_model)

workflow
```

### Define spatial cross validation

```{r define-cv}
set.seed(123)
block_folds <- spatialsample::spatial_block_cv(data, v = 4, n = 2)

spatialsample::autoplot(block_folds)

# control cross-validation
keep_pred <- tune::control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE, save_workflow = TRUE)
```

### Define tuning grid for feature selection

```{r tuning-grid}
prop_grid <- tibble::tibble(
    prop_terms = seq(0.5, 1.0, by = 0.1)  
)
prop_grid
```

### Tune model with spatial cross-validation

```{r tune-model}
set.seed(123)

rf_tuned <- tune::tune_grid(
  workflow,
  resamples = block_folds,
  grid      = prop_grid,
  control   = keep_pred
)

rf_tuned
```

#### RMSE across tuning parameter values

```{r roc-metrics}
metrics_all <- tune::collect_metrics(rf_tuned)

metrics_rmse <- metrics_all %>% 
  dplyr::filter(.metric == "rmse") %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(mean)

metrics_rmse
```

```{r roc-metrics-table, results='asis'}
knitr::kable(
  metrics_rmse,
  caption = "RMSE across different values of prop_terms (feature selection fraction).",
  digits = 3
)
```

```{r roc-metrics-plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
ggplot(metrics_rmse, aes(x = prop_terms, y = mean)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - std_err, ymax = mean + std_err), width = 0.02) +
  labs(
    x = "Fraction of Predictors Kept (prop_terms)",
    y = "Mean RMSE",
    title = "RMSE vs. Feature Selection Fraction",
    subtitle = "Error bars show +/- 1 standard error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

#### Overall metrics

```{r collect-metrics}
metrics_all
```

```{r fold-metrics}
rf_tuned$.metrics  # metrics from each fold (list-column)
```

### Model performance

#### Select best prop_terms by RMSE

```{r}
## Select best prop_terms by RMSE (lower is better)
best_prop <- tune::select_best(rf_tuned, metric = "rmse")
best_prop

## Predictions for the best tuning configuration (across CV folds)
preds <- tune::collect_predictions(rf_tuned, parameters = best_prop)
preds
```

#### Regression metrics

```{r}
# RMSE
rmse_best <- yardstick::rmse(
  preds,
  truth = dep_var,
  estimate = .pred
)

# R²
rsq_best <- yardstick::rsq(
  preds,
  truth = dep_var,
  estimate = .pred
)

# MAE (Mean Absolute Error)
mae_best <- yardstick::mae(
  preds,
  truth = dep_var,
  estimate = .pred
)
cat("RMSE:", round(rmse_best$.estimate, 3), "\n")
cat("R²:",   round(rsq_best$.estimate, 3), "\n")
cat("MAE:",  round(mae_best$.estimate, 3), "\n")
```

#### Transform back from logarithmic scale

```{r}
# preds has columns: dep_var (log scale truth) and .pred (log scale prediction)

preds_orig <- preds %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    truth_orig = exp(dep_var),
    pred_orig  = exp(.pred)
  )

mae_orig <- yardstick::mae(
  preds_orig,
  truth = truth_orig,
  estimate = pred_orig
)

# Compute RMSE in original units
rmse_orig <- yardstick::rmse(
  preds_orig,
  truth = truth_orig,
  estimate = pred_orig
)

cat("MAE on original scale:", round(mae_orig$.estimate, 3), "\n")
cat("RMSE on original scale:", round(rmse_orig$.estimate, 3), "\n")
```

#### Save as dataframe

```{r}
results_df <- data.frame(
  Model = selected_model,
  R2 = rsq_best,
  RMSE = rmse_best,
  MAE = mae_best,
  RMSE_orig = rmse_orig,
  MAE_orig = mae_orig
)
```

#### Plot predicted vs. actual

```{r}
ggplot(preds, aes(x = dep_var, y = .pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Actual values (dep_var)",
    y = "Predicted values",
    title = "Actual vs Predicted (spatial cv RF Regression)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Fit final model with tuned feature selection

```{r fit-final-model}
## Finalize workflow with best prop_terms
final_wf <- finalize_workflow(workflow, best_prop)

set.seed(123)

rf_final <- final_wf %>%
  fit(data = trainDat)

rf_final
```

#### Feature importance for final model

```{r feature-importance}
imp <- extract_fit_parsnip(rf_final) %>%
  vip::vip(num_features = 50)
imp

var_imp <- imp[["data"]]
```

#### Extract predictors finally used

```{r}
predictors_used <- var_imp %>% 
  select(-Importance)

predictors_used
```

## SHAP / Shapley values

### 1) Get exact data used by the workflow

```{r}
set.seed(123)

mold <- workflows::extract_mold(rf_final)
X_all <- as.data.frame(mold$predictors)
y_all <- mold$outcomes[[1]]

# Engine model
rf_fit <- workflows::extract_fit_engine(rf_final)

# Prediction wrapper for regression
pred_fun <- function(object, newdata) {
  predict(object, data = newdata)$predictions
}
```

### 2) Compute SHAP on subset

```{r}
set.seed(123)

shap_mat <- fastshap::explain(
  object       = rf_fit,
  X            = X_all,
  pred_wrapper = pred_fun,
  nsim         = 100,
  adjust       = TRUE
)

dim(shap_mat)
```


## Save output

```{r}
# variable importance
write_rds(var_imp, paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_table_varimp_", selected_model, ".rds"))
# predictors used
write_rds(predictors_used, paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_predictors_used_", selected_model, ".rds"))
# RF model
write_rds(rf_final, paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_rf_model_", selected_model, ".rds"))
# Model performance
write_rds(results_df, paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_model_performance_", selected_model, ".rds"))
# Prediction data for prediction vs. observed plots
write_rds(preds, paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_actual_vs_pred_", selected_model, ".rds"))
# SHAP matrix
write_rds(shap_mat, paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_shap_matrix_", selected_model, ".rds"))
# SHAP X data frame
write_rds(X_all, paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_shap_x_dataframe_", selected_model, ".rds"))
```
